identity.insurer_name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
identity.renewal_terms: AgeLock feature: Your entry-age premium locks until you make your first claim.
identity.geographic_availability: Pan-India coverage with no zone co-payments.

coverage.inpatient_hospitalization: Covered up to Sum Insured for all hospitalization costs.
coverage.daycare_procedures: All daycare procedures covered without sub-limits.
coverage.domiciliary_hospitalization: Covered up to base Sum Insured.
coverage.home_healthcare: Covered for specified treatments at home.
coverage.ayush_treatment: Covered up to base Sum Insured in government AYUSH centers.
coverage.ambulance_cover: Road ambulance covered up to actuals; Air ambulance up to ₹2.5 Lakh.
coverage.modern_treatments: Covered up to Sum Insured without capping.
coverage.restoration_benefit: ReAssure+ Forever: Unlimited restoration triggered after first claim, stays active forever.
coverage.cumulative_bonus: Booster+: Unused sum insured carries forward up to 5x to 10x base cover.
coverage.wellness_benefits: Live Healthy wellness program with up to 30% discount on renewal premium based on step count.

restrictions.room_rent_capping: No Room Rent Capping (Any room category: Single Private AC, Shared, or Deluxe). Zero proportionate deduction.
restrictions.icu_sub_limit: No ICU sub-limit (Covered up to Sum Insured).
restrictions.pre_authorization_rules: 48 hours prior for planned, 24 hours for emergency.
restrictions.non_payable_items: Covered if Safeguard+ rider is selected (pays for non-payable consumables).

premium.pricing_factors: Age at entry (locked via AgeLock until first claim), family size, sum insured.
premium.medical_underwriting: Tele-underwriting and medical checkup as per underwriting grid.
premium.cancellation_refund_terms: Full refund within 15 days free-look; pro-rata short period thereafter.

claims.cashless_claim_procedure: Present Niva Bupa Health Card at network hospital -> approval in 30 minutes.
claims.reimbursement_claim_procedure: File via Niva Bupa Health App -> upload bills -> fast reimbursement.
